title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: How Building and Stability Work!
author: Primitive Nomad

Best way to do this is to frame the house before you build walls and roof. Layout the foundation ls whatever shape you want. Then set your support beams on every corner bring your beams up to your roof height and build rafters and trusses like a real roof. 

It is not true  to that you cannot correct stability sometimes. You have to frame the house and create stability learn to build like an architect not an ark survival player. Foundation —-> shape ——> frame, rafter,truss —-> walls roofs = stable build as large and high as you want.
